scope: Same known manual pages 166–167; additional combinations and requests, not independent unseen-source evaluation

questions.question_en: With Protein G Sepharose, pressure is rising and the foulant is unknown. What does the cleaning section distinguish before a recipe can be selected?
questions.question_fr: Avec Protein G Sepharose, la contre-pression augmente et le dépôt est inconnu. Que distingue la section de nettoyage avant de choisir une recette ?
questions.rationale: Need general indication and both deposit categories; no confirmed foulant diagnosis required.

questions.question_en: What reduced flow rate in mL/min does the MabSelect section specify for cleaning with 30% 2-propanol?
questions.question_fr: Quel débit réduit en mL/min la section MabSelect précise-t-elle pour un nettoyage au 2-propanol à 30 % ?
questions.rationale: Return available solvent context/warning; no exact numeric flow rate in the selected section.

questions.question_en: Compare the nonionic-detergent route on Protein A Sepharose with the one on MabSelect, including wash conditions.
questions.question_fr: Compare la voie avec détergent non ionique sur Protein A Sepharose à celle sur MabSelect, avec les conditions de lavage.
questions.rationale: Distinct examples/volumes and follow-up wash requirements; do not transfer the page-166 temperature/duration to page 167.

questions.question_en: On Protein A Sepharose, give both the ethanol hold time and the volume of ethanol required for the hydrophobic-deposit alternative.
questions.question_fr: Sur Protein A Sepharose, donne à la fois la durée de maintien et le volume d’éthanol de l’alternative visant les dépôts hydrophobes.
questions.rationale: 12 h is available; ethanol volume is not given. Refuse only the unsupported component and retain warning.

questions.question_en: Can the 100–500 mM sodium hydroxide sequence for MabSelect SuRe LX be treated as the Protein G Sepharose cleaning procedure?
questions.question_fr: Peut-on considérer la séquence à 100–500 mM de soude pour MabSelect SuRe LX comme la procédure de nettoyage de Protein G Sepharose ?
questions.rationale: Compare explicitly restricted block and other family reference; no claim of a universal prohibition.

questions.question_en: Is pH 7.0–8.0 stated for the binding-buffer wash after the MabSelect detergent route, and what other wash conditions accompany it?
questions.question_fr: Le pH 7,0–8,0 est-il indiqué pour le lavage au tampon après la voie détergent MabSelect, et quelles autres conditions l’accompagnent ?
questions.rationale: Immediate, at least 5 CV, sterile filtered binding buffer; pH given, without extrapolation.

questions.question_en: Why does the MabSelect solvent paragraph mention increasing gradients and lower flow, and does it specify a pressure limit in bar?
questions.question_fr: Pourquoi le paragraphe sur les solvants MabSelect mentionne-t-il des gradients croissants et un débit plus faible, et précise-t-il une limite de pression en bar ?
questions.rationale: Air-bubble precaution and increased backpressure are sourced; numerical limit is not. Do not invent one.

questions.question_en: For Protein A Sepharose, does the 6 M guanidine hydrochloride cleaning block specify a contact time?
questions.question_fr: Pour Protein A Sepharose, le bloc de nettoyage au chlorhydrate de guanidine 6 M précise-t-il un temps de contact ?
questions.rationale: Two washes are given but no contact time in this block; do not borrow page-167 minimum 10 minutes.
